task: Deepen (flagship 2) ai-bookkeeper, BUILDABLE HERE: re-measure the CLI's --four-pass on SRD photos; photo 1173's refused item split
errors: A first version of the items-above-the-subtotal retry kept a split against a largest-amount guess (SRD 1160) and took OCR's 'Subtota]' as an item (SRD 1060); both caught by reading the new splits by eye and fixed before CORD was scored.

doc_friction.issue: --misses lists only total misses, not tax misses, and nothing scores item splits; a short scratch script was needed for both.
The committed CORD files drop the upstream item labels, so item splits can only be checked against the labelled total, not item by item.

notes: Installed tesseract 5.3.4 (apt). CLI --four-pass on 200 SRD photos (4 shards, ~25 min): totals 150/196 (last 147), tax 126/185 (first CLI figure; page 138). Change: tax-block lines excluded from items; retry on lines above the first subtotal/total line, only against a total read from a total line; 'Subtota' not an item. Item splits kept: SRD 42->48 (in-sample, all 6 read by eye), CORD train/val/test 342/51/49 -> 436/62/60 (held out; 115 of 116 new close the labelled total, 1 has none). Totals and tax unchanged on SRD CLI and CORD. Venture suite: ok ai-bookkeeper (3270 tests). Page item splits not re-measured (tesseract.js readings not rebuilt).
